policy: A question is VERIFIED_PYQ only after its exact wording, options, exam/year/paper, and official answer are checked against authoritative evidence. An official portal URL alone is not per-question verification.

papers.paper: Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination - General Studies Paper I, Test Booklet Series A
papers.notes: A regression test screens 30 distinctive short fragments anchored to questions in this official paper against all six static banks (seed, expanded, priority, mapped question bank, catalog bank, and CSAT bank). Result: 0/30 exact normalized phrase matches. This is a narrow literal screen, not semantic similarity, not a full paper-to-bank match, and not item-level answer-key verification. No item was promoted to VERIFIED_PYQ.

sources.answer_key_archive_notes: The official UPSC Answer Keys Archives page is accessible, but its examination filter is JavaScript-driven and the current text view does not expose the 2023 CSE Prelims answer-key document link. Therefore the 2023 GS-I answer key was not independently retrieved from the official archive in this pass.

sources.notes: SSC's official notice confirms the 2024 Tier-I final answer keys and candidate response sheets were accessible from 19 December 2024 to 8 January 2025 via registered login and would not remain available afterward. The 2025 Tier-I notice says final answer keys and question papers would be published later; that notice is not itself an item-level question source. No static bank item has been matched to an SSC response sheet or final answer key in this audit. The legacy official SSC answer-key portal also lists the Combined Graduate Level Examination (Tier-I), 2023 final answer key along with candidate response sheets. Access to an individual candidate's response sheet may still be login-bound; no static-bank item has been matched to a specific official 2023 shift/question/answer in this pass.
sources.official_2023_tier1_tentative_answer_key: Official notice states CGL Tier-I 2023 was held 14–27 July 2023 and candidate response sheets/tentative answer keys were login-accessible 1–4 August 2023, after which response sheets would not remain available. This confirms historical access limitations, not item-level matches.

sources.notes: The official RBI portal provides Grade B recruitment handouts, including the 2026 Phase-I handout and 2025 Phase-II handouts. Handouts establish exam instructions/format, not that an item appeared in an actual previous exam. No static bank item has been matched to an official past-paper record in this audit.

paper_coverage_check.paper: UPSC CSE Prelims 2023 GS Paper I, Test Booklet Series A
paper_coverage_check.method: Case-insensitive literal term search across six static source-code bank/build files: data/priority_question_bank.js, data/seed_questions.js, data/expanded_question_bank.js, data/csat_questions.js, data/catalog_question_bank.js, data/question_bank.js.
paper_coverage_check.interpretation: None of the 30 literal topic terms probed was found in these six static bank/build files. This is a narrow coverage-gap check, not proof that every related concept is absent and not a substitute for exact stem/options/answer verification. These official-paper questions should be considered candidates for new provenance-backed records only after answer-key verification; do not label existing similar concepts as PYQs.
